# A FuncMap muxt cannot read statically names what muxt can read.

! muxt generate
stderr 'Funcs: cannot read funcs: muxt reads a template.FuncMap literal, or a package-level var or const holding one'

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.22
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var files embed.FS

func build() template.FuncMap { return template.FuncMap{} }

var templates = template.Must(template.New("").Funcs(build()).ParseFS(files, "*"))
-- index.gohtml --
